paragraphs: Whip Around sells fleet management software that helps operators cut downtime, stay compliant, and replace paper inspections with digital workflows. Coverage runs from vehicles and equipment to supplies and facilities.

Drivers complete customizable digital inspections tied to the fleet's daily compliance. What they find feeds work orders, service schedules and preventative tasks. Compliance workflows are centralized around DOT, state and company requirements. Preventive maintenance schedules can be triggered by mileage or engine hours through connected telematics tools.

The company says it began in 2016, helping freight companies in New Zealand with a paper-based compliance burden. It reports serving thousands of customers with hundreds of thousands of users. Its customer base is described as commercial fleets in all industries, from delivery and distribution to agriculture and construction. Public agencies appear in its case studies, including the Town of New Milford. Another case study covers Poudre Fire Authority.

quote.text: Whip Around was born in 2016, originally to help freight companies in New Zealand tackle their paper-based compliance burden.
